QUOTE: the default expansion is `private_##member`, so `ctx->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(alg)` becomes `ctx->private_alg`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the default rename to `private_<member>`. It also says that inside code defining `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS`, "`MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` is just `x`", which is the unchanged-member expansion.
